identity_lookup.name: verify_granted_identity
identity_lookup.description: Decode the Dex-issued ID token returned from the token endpoint to determine which identity Dex authenticated and what claims were bound to it.

response_fields.refresh_token: Refresh token if issued; SAML connector ignores offline_access so typically absent
